layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for record search
Add search tests and verification report

graderOnly: src/search.js never applies the documented 50-item page-size cap: with 120 matching records and pageSize=200, GET /records/search returns all 120 items and reports pageSize 200, contrary to docs/api.md (Paging), AC-004, and the design's AC-004 technical acceptance criterion.
GET /records (src/records.js) caps pageSize at 50 correctly and is unaffected.

test/search.test.js never requests a pageSize above 50, so the full test suite passes and the COMPLETE verification report does not reveal the defect; the missing cap scenario is also a Tester coverage gap.
No review report exists before the run.

all.why: the report must exist at the fixed implementation-review path
artifact init writes this provenance block

selfChecks.why: the existing and Tester-added tests pass, as the COMPLETE verification report records

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const { handle } = await import(`./src/handlers.js`); const { createStore } = await import(`./src/store.js`); const store = createStore(Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Ann ` + i, email: `ann` + i + `@example.org` }))); const { body } = handle(`GET`, `/records/search?q=ann&pageSize=200`, store); console.log(body.items.length, body.pageSize); process.exit(body.items.length > 50 ? 0 : 1);'
selfChecks.why: the search endpoint ignores the documented 50-item page-size cap

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const { handle } = await import(`./src/handlers.js`); const { createStore } = await import(`./src/store.js`); const store = createStore(Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Ann ` + i, email: `ann` + i + `@example.org` }))); const { body } = handle(`GET`, `/records?pageSize=200`, store); console.log(body.items.length, body.pageSize); process.exit(body.items.length === 50 && body.pageSize === 50 ? 0 : 1);'
selfChecks.why: the existing list endpoint applies the documented cap, so the rule is established project behavior

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): records-api, a dependency-free Node ESM in-memory API with GET /records whose paging (default 20, max 50) is documented in docs/api.md 'Paging' and implemented and tested in src/records.js and test/records.test.js. 50-plan: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004; AC-004 requires the documented paging rules including the 50 cap), design (technical criterion: pageSize above 50 yields pageSize 50 and at most 50 items), STATE at DEVELOPING. 60-implementation: src/search.js plus the route in src/handlers.js; the page size is clamped only from below, so it ignores the cap; development plan COMPLETE (AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE); STATE at TESTING. 70-verification: test/search.test.js (5 scenarios, none above 50), package.json test script, verification report COMPLETE (FULL/NONE) citing commits and blobs, STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with a FORWARD handoff from TESTING, no recovery, and no review report. The spec sets date 2026-09-28 so commits follow the cycle ID timestamp.
